question: Where must the seed taken from the pot be ritually placed?
premises: The seed is taken from the pot.
The placement location is the heart of the image.
The action is prescribed as an injunction.
inference: One should take the seed from the pot and place it in the heart of the image.
uncertainties: bījam may refer to a mantra-seed or ritual seed; context suggests mantra-seed
plain_english: Having taken the seed from the pot, one should place it in the heart of the image.
